title: Concord WebSocket contract
description:
The current bidirectional WebSocket payloads.

This is a generation root rather than a second wire model: both fields point
directly at the types serialized and deserialized by the production socket.

AuditLogEntry.description: Audit log entry sent to clients.

AutomodRuleInfo.description: AutoMod rule info sent to clients.

BotTokenInfo.description: Bot token info (without the actual hash).

CategoryInfo.description: Channel category metadata sent to clients.

ChannelPermissionOverrideInfo.description: A role- or member-specific permission rule for one channel.

ChannelPositionInfo.description: Minimal channel position info for reorder events.

ChatEvent.description:
Protocol-agnostic event that flows through the chat engine.
Both IRC and WebSocket adapters produce and consume these.

oneOf.description: Protocol-v2 synchronization snapshot at an opaque durable cursor.
Current authorized projection of a durable event descriptor.
The supplied cursor cannot safely resume and the client must replace cached state.
Correlated stable command failure for protocol-v2 clients.

Correlated acceptance of a non-durable lifecycle command.

Clients add `request_id` to the command object. Serde deliberately
ignores that field on older command variants, while the WebSocket
adapter retains it and emits this result only after the command has
completed successfully.
Durable correlated result for edit/delete/reaction/read commands.
A message sent to a channel or as a DM.

conversation_id.description: Canonical conversation identifier, present for direct messages.

oneOf.description:
Acknowledgment sent back to the sender with the server-generated message ID.
The nonce matches the client-provided value so the frontend can update the optimistic message.

sequence.description: Decimal string to preserve the full SQLite integer range in JavaScript.

oneOf.description: A reaction was added to a message.
A reaction was removed from a message.
A user started typing in a channel.
Server notice directed at a specific session.
Current topic of a channel (sent on join).
Response to a channel list request.
List of servers the user belongs to.
Unread message counts for channels in a server.
Link embed previews were resolved for a message.
List of roles in a server.

member_roles.description: Present for an authoritative bootstrap; absent for a metadata-only mutation.

oneOf.description: A role was created or updated.
Authoritative permission rules for one channel.
List of categories in a server.
A category was created or updated.
Presence update for a user (broadcast to shared server members).
Bulk presence list for a server (sent on connect/join).
The authenticated user's durable preference and current projected state.
A user's profile was fetched or updated.
Message was pinned in a channel.
Message was unpinned from a channel.
List of all pinned messages in a channel.
A thread was archived or unarchived.
List of threads for a channel.
Complete tag selection for a thread.
A member was kicked from the server.
A member was banned from the server.
A ban was removed from the server.
Result of an explicit announcement publication request.
A new server created atomically from a versioned template.
An interaction was created (sent to the bot).
An interaction response (sent back to the channel).
Correlated acceptance of a slash command or message component invocation.
Bot tokens list response (sent only to the bot owner).
Bot accounts controlled by the authenticated owner.
A newly issued secret. The raw token is emitted exactly once.
Result of sharing a message to Bluesky.
Explicit correlation envelope for non-durable lifecycle commands.

sequence.description: Decimal JSON string; JavaScript clients must not parse this as a number.

DirectConversationInfo.description: Direct conversation navigation entry sent only to a participant.

EmbedAuthor.description: Author section for a rich embed.

EmbedField.description: A field in a rich embed.

EmbedInfo.description: Open Graph link embed preview metadata.

EventInfo.description: Scheduled event info sent to clients.

InviteInfo.description: Server invite info sent to clients.

MemberRoleInfo.description: One member's role assignments in an authoritative role bootstrap.

MessageComponent.description: A message component (button, select menu, or action row).

PresenceInfo.description: User presence info sent to clients.

ReactionGroup.description: Grouped reactions for a message in history.

RichEmbedInfo.description: Rich embed format for bot messages.

SearchResultMessage.description: A search result message (same as HistoryMessage but with channel info).

SelectOption.description: An option in a select menu component.

rules_accepted.description:
Whether the requesting member accepted the server's current rules version.
Omitted from public discovery results.

my_permissions.description: Effective permission bitfield for the requesting user in this server.

SlashCommandChoice.description: A pre-defined choice for a slash command option.

SlashCommandInfo.description: Slash command info sent to clients.

SlashCommandOption.description: A single option/parameter for a slash command.
